clauses.section: ## CL-D40 — Missing worktree paths require exact registration evidence
requires: a missing path does not prove a stale worktree registration
unverifiable identity yields no mutation command
The exact external removal is never executed by the workflow

new owner action outside the failed run

clauses.title: Black-box recovery tests preserve unrelated registrations
requires: unrelated missing registrations cannot break a fresh linked workspace
exact missing registration collision returns bounded read-only evidence
wrong-head and branch registrations never become exact removal candidates
locked missing registrations never become exact removal candidates
receipt failure reports partial creation without automatic cleanup
exact-path remove must leave the unrelated stale registration
